_comment: #396 winter_teeth_talk + winter_teeth_work's start: warrior5+mage5 at riverfarm_village (12,10) facing right, directly west of the shepherd (13,10) -- first interact plays his talk_pool line, the second opens riverfarm_hunter. Copied from thicket_talk_start (the region's shipped baseline: post-mounting, door_awakened + riverfarm_attuned, blight_lifted + price_of_a_favor_reported so the region's side quests are legally reachable) with NOTHING added: heard_winter_teeth is unbanked, so the hub shows exactly two rows and the offer is earned live, and heard_thicket_keeps is unbanked too, which keeps every legacy thicket row hidden and the hub small enough to recount by hand. DAY (actions_since_sleep 0) is load-bearing: river_wolf_pack's encounter_when needs night, so both these routes are provably combat-free with the pack disarmed. winter_fold_hurdles (15,12) and wolf_sign_trail (4,13) are both ABSENT at this state (present_when requires heard_winter_teeth), which is what makes the walk-onto-the-cell absence proofs sound. TRAP: rng_state is DERIVED (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd), never hand-typed; WISave restores .state directly and RNG_STATE_MIN_MAGNITUDE rejects small ints.
